definitions.short: a cooking range (consisting of two parallel stones, across which the boiler is set)
definitions.full: H3600. kir [ כִּיר ] noun [masculine] cooking-furnace (Mishna כִּירָה ) — frangible, only dual כִּירַיִם Lev 11:35 (with תַּנּזּר ), perhaps as supporting two pots (Ki); ᵐ5 χυτρόποδες .
definitions.rootNote: a form for 3564 (only in the dual);
